title: context2d labeled contours
explanation:
### Description

Display labeled contours in a 2D context using vtkLabeledContourPolyDataItem.

**dataset → input → filter → plot → item → context_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkAxis](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkAxis.html) — axis.
- [vtkContextActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkContextActor.html) — context actor.
- [vtkContourFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkContourFilter.html) — extracts iso-surfaces at specified scalar values.
- [vtkCutter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCutter.html) — cutter.
- [vtkDoubleArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDoubleArray.html) — double array.
- [vtkInteractiveArea](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkInteractiveArea.html) — interactive area.
- [vtkLabeledContourPolyDataItem](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLabeledContourPolyDataItem.html) — labeled contour poly data item.
- [vtkLookupTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLookupTable.html) — maps scalar values to colors.
- [vtkPlane](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPlane.html) — defines an implicit plane function.
- [vtkRTAnalyticSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRTAnalyticSource.html) — generates a synthetic wavelet image volume.
- [vtkRectd](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRectd.html) — rectd.
- [vtkRecti](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRecti.html) — recti.
- [vtkStripper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStripper.html) — creates triangle strips and/or polylines from polygonal data.
- [vtkTextProperty](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTextProperty.html) — text property.
- [vtkTextPropertyCollection](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTextPropertyCollection.html) — text property collection.
- [vtkUnsignedCharArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkUnsignedCharArray.html) — unsigned char array.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
